verdict.rationale: Wave is accounting software, so an agent answering affordability questions from live ledger data over an API is a fair axis. The pack shows no such capability: the marketing pages document no API, MCP, or agent surface, the developer portal returned 403 and could not be quoted, and llms.txt and OpenAPI probes returned 404. Wave's built-in P&L, balance sheet and cash flow reports are an adjacent feature, not agent-grounded answers through an API.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can ask an agent "can we afford X?" and get an answer grounded in live ledger data pulled through the API
